title: senna mexicana var. shaferi
intro: Senna mexicana var. shaferi, commonly known as Mexican senna, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to stimulate bowel movements and relieve constipation due to its health benefits of promoting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Mexican senna include purgative, laxative, and anthelmintic properties, making it useful in treating various gastrointestinal issues. Bioactive constituents present in Mexican senna include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin, chrysophanic acid, and emodin, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
